meta.interval: 95% paired t, exact Student quantile for the n of each comparison
notes: the run files were read 2 time(s) before the block finished (first 2026-10-14 21:43:44, last 2026-10-15 09:31:32; experiments/smt2020/final/shift_report_dev/interim_looks.log); PROTOCOL_shift.md declares no ban on interim looks
p_holm is null throughout: PROTOCOL_shift.md declares no families of comparisons
the checks of each reading are this script's operationalisation of the protocol's predictions (see each reading's 'operationalised'); the protocol fixes no thresholds

tbl_timeout.label: table from the timeout rule's records, fitted at 0.98

tbl_mbs.label: table from the minimum-batch-size rule's records, fitted at 0.98

tbl_nach.label: table from NACH's records, fitted at 0.98

rft_timeout.label: table from the timeout rule's records, refitted at 0.9

rft_mbs.label: table from the minimum-batch-size rule's records, refitted at 0.9

rft_nach.label: table from NACH's records, refitted at 0.9

R1.prediction: Positive on most seeds at 0.90 and 0.80, since the rule's parameter is as stale as the table, but by less than at 0.98.
R1.operationalised: this script's reading: positive_on_most_seeds = wins > n/2; smaller_than_0p98_mean (_pct) = the mean (the % of the rule) below that of tbl_X-X at 0.98 in final/confirm/results.json

R2.prediction: Positive on every seed, by at least the 0.98 margin.
R2.operationalised: this script's reading: positive_on_every_seed = wins == n > 0; at_least_0p98_mean (_pct) = the mean (the %) at least that of tbl_X-X at 0.98

R3.prediction: Positive where R1 fell short of the 0.98 margin.
R3.operationalised: this script's reading: r1_short_of_0p98_pct = R1's % below the 0.98 %, the condition under which the prediction applies; positive_mean = mean > 0; positive_sign_0p05 = exact sign test p <= 0.05 with more wins than losses

R4.prediction: The timeout and minimum-batch-size tables at least as good as the retuned control limit, as at 0.98.
R4.operationalised: this script's reading: 'at least as good' three ways, none chosen: mean_nonnegative (mean >= 0), noninferior_0p25 (lower end of the 95% interval above -0.25, the C2 margin of PROTOCOL_confirm.md), superior_sign_0p05 (sign test p <= 0.05, more wins than losses); timeout and mbs only, against the retuned control limit (the control limit at 1.5 h when the retuned threshold is 1.5 h)

R5.prediction: At the lower rates the threshold rises (an under-full run costs less capacity, and a load takes longer to fill), and the refitted tables start earlier in the same way; the direction of the change is read off the tables' entries.
R5.operationalised: this script's reading: threshold_direction = h* against 1.5 h; a table starts earlier when it starts in cells where the 0.98 table waits and waits in none where that one starts; checks at rates below 0.98 only: threshold_rises, tables_start_earlier (all three rules), same_direction (higher with earlier, lower with later, same with same)

R6.prediction: Control limits on the residual whose thresholds do not fall with the time to the next arrival, and the number of entries that differ from the 0.98 tables.
R6.operationalised: control_limit_form = no adjacent pair of cells at which the start region is not closed downward in the residual or shrinks as the arrival moves later (confirm_report.table_facts); cells_differ_0p98 = entries of the start map that differ from the 0.98 table of the same rule

cells.prediction: Cells with both actions at least n0 times in the new records, per rule.
cells.operationalised: cells_both = of the cells, those in which the new records hold each action at least n0 (K0) times (confirm_report.table_facts)
